recipe.subject: Hovel of the Relic
recipe.notes: A humble monks’ refuge. A tiny wooden cross over the entrance; a subdued golden glint within.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept

Asset type: one 2048×2048 four-view concept atlas for Pilgrimage. Four equal 1024×1024 cells in a 2×2 layout. This is ONE building rotated, not four variants.

Style contract: pilgrimage-buildings-v2 — Ink & thatch.

Subject: Hovel of the Relic. Footprint exactly 5 × 5 ground tiles. One tile is one world unit. Walls 1.8 units high; roof rises 1.65 units above the eaves.

Construction: A broad hipped thatch roof with four sloping faces and rounded weathered eaves. Earthen plaster with restrained exposed timber. Entrance in the south wall. Warm limewashed daub, dark oak framing, low rough stone footing, tiny shuttered windows, a clear open doorway.

Art direction: Slightly irregular ink contours; broad, quiet colour washes. Thick straw eaves, limewashed daub, visible timber and a low stone footing. A clear entrance and a useful silhouette before surface detail. Sparse hatching follows the material: down the straw, along the grain. One orthographic camera, consistent scale, light from the upper left. Original medieval history-book illustration; flat restrained watercolour with confident dark brown pen lines.

Palette: ink #352b24, plaster #e7d8b9, timber #715139, thatch #c4a05f, thatchShade #927344, stone #a29c8b, moss #7e8860. Muted blue-grey shade.

Required view order: top-left 0 southeast (south entrance + east wall); top-right 1 northeast (north rear + east wall); bottom-left 2 northwest (north rear + west wall); bottom-right 3 southwest (south entrance + west wall). The entrance always remains on the south side. Rear views must show a solid rear wall, not another door. Rotate the whole building in 90° steps; never mirror or invent new windows.

Camera: match the supplied isometric registration guide exactly. Orthographic, elevation 35.26438968°, yaw 45° + view index × 90°. Ground axes rise at 30° to horizontal; verticals stay vertical. No perspective convergence. Footprint corners, ridge direction, width, depth and height must register across all four views.

Registration in EVERY cell: ground-centre anchor at (50%,72%); scale 0.097980 of cell width per world unit (100.33 px/unit at 1024). Use the supplied guide as the geometry and placement authority. Walls and roof stay inside the 5×5 tile reservation. Do not independently centre or scale individual views.

Composition: exactly four complete buildings, one per quadrant, with the same anchor, scale and geometry. No borders or gaps between cells. Erase guide grid, red registration dots and labels from the finished art. No terrain islands or external shadows. Preserve large shapes at 128px per view.

Backdrop: uniform warm ivory #f3eddf. This is a concept, not an alpha-ready sprite.

Details: A humble monks’ refuge. A tiny wooden cross over the entrance; a subdued golden glint within.

Avoid: text, labels, people, landscape, glossy 3D, photorealism, pixel art, excessive fine hatching, ornate fantasy architecture. Roof intact unless explicitly requested otherwise.

Input roles: image 1 is the mandatory four-view geometric registration guide; any further image is a material and line-style reference. Preserve guide geometry even if the style reference has looser perspective. All four views must describe the same building.
This is a precise paint-over of the attached four-view blockout. KEEP EVERY BUILDING'S EXISTING SIZE, POSITION, CORNER POSITIONS, LOW WALL HEIGHT AND ROOF HEIGHT. Do not enlarge or centre the subjects. Do not convert these low, broad buildings into tall cottages. Paint only inside the existing silhouettes, with tiny eave fringes. Remove lettering, grid lines and red dots, leaving plain ivory. Use simple lightly wobbly ink and flat pale straw and cream washes, with only sparse groups of reed strokes. The rear (north) wall is plain, with no doors, windows or cross. Each long side (east and west) has exactly one centred shuttered window. Thus view0 has door LEFT/window RIGHT; view1 has window LEFT/plain rear RIGHT; view2 has plain rear LEFT/window RIGHT; view3 has window LEFT/door RIGHT. Entrance has one tiny cross. Four consistent views, not alternate designs. Keep guide geometry exact.

placement.status: Four views required. Registration values are targets; compare generated pixels against the grid before game integration.

generator: Built-in image_gen tool; model ID not exposed
registration: Source PNG is preserved. Workshop preview and fitted exports apply the recorded ground-corner transforms. Ivory concept; alpha is not production-ready.
